# `aitbc agent-comm reputation`

Update the reputation score for an agent based on an interaction result.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm reputation [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--interaction-result` | choice | — | yes | The Interaction result. |
| `--feedback` | float | — | no | Feedback score (0.0-1.0) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm reputation --agent-id <agent_id> --interaction-result <interaction_result>
```
